name: Hollow Wretch
lore: A small Gateborn husk formed from erased memory. It attacks in groups and leaves cold silence behind when destroyed.
visualDescription: Thin charcoal humanoid shard-body, incomplete mask, white cracks, no faction marks.
mapBehavior: Rushes isolated Titans and punishes careless positioning.

name: Gateborn Colossus
lore: A giant malformed guardian grown around unstable Gate stone. It is not a Titan and has no civilization; it is a defensive catastrophe.
visualDescription: Massive stone-black creature with gateway ribs, glowing fracture-core, many broken arch fragments embedded in its shoulders.
mapBehavior: Controls central objectives and forces Titans to split pressure.

name: Beast Realm Maneater
lore: A predator from a Beast Realm where instinct became law. It is not evil in a human sense; it is a living argument that survival has no court of appeal.
visualDescription: Mythic lion-wolf-serpent predator, bone mane, ember eyes, ancient scars, earth-dark hide, non-sci-fi monster silhouette.
mapBehavior: Tracks wounded Titans and escalates if ignored.

name: Forgotten Standard Bearer
lore: A remnant of a removed civilization whose name cannot be safely spoken. It carries a banner that remembers wars the Codex refuses to restore.
visualDescription: Tall armored remnant with faceless helm, shredded banner of erased sigils, rusted mythic plate, ash falling upward.
mapBehavior: Buffs lesser Hollow enemies and creates denial zones.

name: Ancient World Boss: Leviathan of the First Flood
lore: A catastrophic primordial beast awakened when multiple Gate scars align beneath ancient waters. It is a campaign-scale threat, not a faction unit.
visualDescription: Colossal mythic sea serpent-dragon made of stormwater, basalt scales, drowned temple chains, moonlit eyes, and tidal crown horns.
mapBehavior: Campaign boss encounter that transforms terrain each phase.
